metadata.description:
This free digital card was made by an Independent Creator and published on Yoto Space. Visit Open Mic on Yoto Space to discover more great free titles!  

Creator: Joséphine et Rémy  
From the Creator: “Joséphine et Rémy write songs for children that grownups love... or is it the opposite??   
The duo is composed of Joséphine Ancelle and Rémy de Laroque, two French singer-songwriters who live in NYC, teach music to children, and write and perform together for the French community in and around New York. Many of their songs take root directly from children's words, caught in magical moments during classes. 

After their single, "On a gagné", about persistence and endurance, and their first album, "Haiku Boku" (short songs inspired by the Japanese style of poems) released in December 2024, Joséphine et Rémy released "En regardant les étoiles," in December 2025. The songs all vary in style ranging from delicate folk, to pop anthems, to playful punk, all tied together with Rémy's guitar and Joséphine's ukulele.”  

For ages: 0-10+ 
If your family enjoyed this card, why not let the creator know by adding a comment on Open Mic?  

Featured on Discover until 31st March 
Stays in your library and available on Yoto Space at any time
